title: Entire Partners Sarvam to Bring AI Coding Agents to India
summary: Thomas Dohmke's Entire joins forces with Sarvam AI to deploy AI coding agents across India, targeting local developers with region-optimized tools.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Entire and Sarvam AI announce partnership to deploy AI coding agents optimized for Indian developers on November 25, 2026.
- The collaboration targets India's rapidly growing software development sector with region-specific coding tools and language support.
- Partnership reflects strategic focus on emerging markets where AI adoption in software development is accelerating significantly.


Thomas Dohmke's Entire has joined forces with Sarvam AI to bring AI[coding agents](https://emergent.sh/glossary/coding-agent) to India's developer community. Officially launched on November 25, 2026, the partnership targets one of the world's fastest-growing software development markets with locally optimized coding assistance tools designed for regional workflows and infrastructure constraints.


## Partnership Details and Scope


The collaboration between Entire and Sarvam AI combines Entire's coding agent technology with Sarvam's deep understanding of the Indian technology ecosystem. The partnership aims to deliver AI-powered development tools that address specific challenges faced by Indian software teams, including multilingual code documentation, regional cloud infrastructure optimization, and support for local development frameworks. According to the announcement, the joint offering will be available through both cloud-based and on-premises deployment models to accommodate diverse enterprise requirements across India's tech sector.


## Strategic Focus on Indian Market


India represents a critical growth market for AI development tools. The country hosts over 5 million software developers, with that number projected to grow substantially through 2027. Sarvam AI brings crucial local expertise to the partnership, having previously launched India-hosted AI infrastructure that addresses data sovereignty and latency concerns. The collaboration positions both companies to capture market share in a region where domestic AI solutions are increasingly preferred over international alternatives. Entire's coding agents will be adapted to support common Indian development scenarios, including work with legacy enterprise systems and hybrid cloud architectures.


The partnership also addresses language localization beyond code, with plans to support developer documentation and interface elements in multiple Indian languages. This localization strategy reflects recognition that English-only tools create barriers for many developers in tier-2 and tier-3 Indian cities, where much of the country's software talent growth is concentrated.


## Technical Capabilities and Integration


The[AI coding agents](https://emergent.sh/ai-agent-builder/coding) deployed through this partnership offer several core capabilities:


- Automated code completion and generation for popular frameworks used in Indian enterprises
- Real-time bug detection and security vulnerability scanning
- Code review automation with context awareness for regional compliance requirements
- Integration with Indian cloud providers and development platforms


Developers will access the tools through familiar integrated development environments, with support for Visual Studio Code, JetBrains IDEs, and locally popular editors. The agents leverage machine learning models trained on both global open-source repositories and India-specific codebases to provide relevant suggestions for local development patterns.


## Availability and Access


The Entire-Sarvam coding agents became available to Indian developers starting November 25, 2026. Early access programs are being offered to select enterprise customers and developer communities across major Indian tech hubs including Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Pune. The companies plan broader general availability rollout through early 2027, with pricing models designed to accommodate Indian market conditions including startup-friendly tiers and educational institution licensing.


## What This Means


This partnership signals growing recognition among global AI companies that successful market penetration in India requires local partnerships and region-specific adaptation. For Indian developers, the collaboration promises access to advanced coding assistance tools optimized for their specific workflows and infrastructure. The move also reflects broader trends in AI tool localization, where generic global products increasingly face competition from regionally tailored alternatives. As India continues expanding its position as a global software development hub, partnerships like Entire-Sarvam will likely become more common, potentially reshaping how international AI companies approach one of the world's largest developer markets.
